subtitle: Additive Low-End Generator
tagline: Creates new bass at the frequency you choose, independent of the input pitch, with focused Core, resonant Bloom, and onset Punch layers and zero latency.

body.lead: TB SubLow is an additive low-frequency engine. It creates new bass at a frequency you choose, independent of the input pitch, and builds that energy beneath the original sound.

body.p: `CORE` generates a focused, stable centre at `TARGET`. `BLOOM` adds resonant body, short diffusion, and subtle harmonics around the low end. `PUNCH` reinforces the onsets, and `RESPONSE` sets how the generated layers follow the body and release of the source. Unlike a fixed rumble generator or an octave-down effect, TB SubLow reacts to full-band mono or stereo material, and it adds no latency.

ul: TARGET from 32 to 250 Hz, independent of the input pitch
Three generated layers: CORE, BLOOM, and PUNCH
RESPONSE sets how quickly the layers follow and release
Zero reported latency; the dry signal is not delayed
Input (DRY) and output (SUM) meters with live Body, Bloom, Punch, and Generated feedback
12 factory presets in three groups, user presets, undo, and redo

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB SubLow 1.3.0 for Windows (VST3). The current macOS build is version 0.1.3 and may differ from the descriptions here.

ol: Insert TB SubLow on a kick, bass, or full mix. The defaults are `TARGET` 55 Hz, `CORE` 30%, `BLOOM` 15%, `PUNCH` 20%, and `RESPONSE` 50%.
Set `TARGET` near the fundamental you want to reinforce, for example the kick's low thump.
Set the amount of steady sub with `CORE`.
Add `PUNCH` for impact on hits, or `BLOOM` for a fuller, resonant body.
Adjust `RESPONSE` for a faster or longer-lasting body.
Match the level with `OUTPUT` and compare with bypass on small speakers and headphones.

Sets the centre frequency of the generated low layer. It is not a filter cutoff or a pitch shifter.
Sets the amount of narrow, stable generated low end. Too much stacks on top of the original bass.
Sets the amount of modal, diffused low-frequency bloom: resonant body, short diffusion, and subtle harmonics.
Sets the amount of short, onset-driven low impact. It does not raise sustained loudness.

warn.text: TB SubLow adds new low-frequency energy. Check phase against the original bass, translation on small speakers, and headroom. There is no limiter or true-peak protection.

body.p: Step through factory presets with the arrows, or open the list to choose a factory or user preset. SAVE stores the current settings as a .tbsl preset. UNDO and REDO step through recent parameter and preset changes.

body.p: Starting points for common jobs. Adjust them by ear.

recipes.title: Kick that translates
recipes.use: A kick that still thumps on small speakers.
steps: Check CORE first, then add PUNCH only on the onset.
Compare with bypass on small speakers.

recipes.title: Fuller bass body
recipes.use: Sustained bass that needs weight without more hits.
steps: Lower CORE and PUNCH if the low end gets crowded.

recipes.title: Cinematic impact
recipes.use: Deep blooms under hits and trailers.
steps: Watch headroom; lower OUTPUT if the sum gets too hot.

recipes.title: Mix floor
recipes.use: Gentle low support under a full mix.
steps: Keep it subtle; it should be felt rather than heard.

rows: The low end gets muddy or too heavy.
Lower CORE and BLOOM, or move TARGET away from the existing bass fundamental.
The low end thins out against the original.
The generated layer may be out of phase with the source bass. Move TARGET slightly and compare.
The bass is lost on small speakers.
Try Upper Bass Pulse or raise TARGET above the usual sub range.
Lower OUTPUT; TB SubLow has no limiter.
